title: Dynamic language model representations for multi-objective reaction optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2609.11790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimising chemical reactions across multiple objectives, such as yield, selectivity, and safety, is central to chemical synthesis, and model-driven approaches depend critically on how reaction components are represented. Established featurisations are either chemically uninformative, as with one-hot encodings, or, as with molecular descriptors, do not readily extend across chemically distinct components. For structurally and functionally diverse components, it is therefore unclear what a shared representation should contain. Constructing such a representation is itself a challenging research undertaking that must be revisited for each new reaction system. Here we bypass this step by learning the reaction representation dynamically from text. translated_title: 用于多目标反应优化的动态语言模型表示
translated_abstract: 在产率、选择性和安全性等多个目标之间优化化学反应是化学合成的核心，而模型驱动的方法在很大程度上取决于反应组分的表示方式。已有的特征化方法要么在化学上信息量不足（如独热编码），要么难以推广到化学性质各异的组分（如分子描述符）。因此，对于结构和功能多样的组分，共享表示应当包含什么内容尚不清楚。构建这样的表示本身就是一项具有挑战性的研究工作，而且必须针对每个新的反应系统重新进行。本文通过从文本中动态学习反应表示来绕过这一步骤。反应条件的文本描述由一个与高斯过程代理模型联合训练的微调语言模型进行编码，从而在多目标优化框架中获得任务自适应的表示。
tldr: 该论文提出利用微调语言模型从反应条件的文本描述中动态学习任务自适应的反应表示，并与高斯过程代理模型联合训练，从而无需为每个新反应系统人工构建特征表示即可实现多目标化学反应优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dynamically learning task-adaptive reaction representations from textual descriptions of reaction conditions using a fine-tuned language model trained jointly with Gaussian process surrogates, enabling multi-objective chemical reaction optimisation without manually constructing feature representations for each new reaction system.
